_meta.description: Reference knowledge base of automotive (vehicle assembly) defect types and their criticality classification. Used to ground AI report generation via RAG so severity ratings are consistent instead of hallucinated.

criticality_levels.Critical: Safety, regulatory (FMVSS/UNECE), or drivability failure risk. Vehicle must be stopped from shipping, quarantined, or reworked under CAPA before release. Includes anything that could trigger a field recall.
criticality_levels.Major: Significant deviation from spec affecting function, durability, or customer perception (e.g., warranty claim risk), but not an immediate safety failure.
criticality_levels.Minor: Cosmetic or low-impact deviation. Does not affect function or safety. Logged for trend monitoring; corrective action optional unless recurring.

defects.description: Incomplete penetration, porosity, or missing weld on a body structural joint (e.g., pillar, rocker, crossmember).
defects.recommended_action: Stop line, quarantine affected VINs, weld lab destructive test on sample, root cause investigation before restart.

defects.description: Detected leak at brake line fitting, caliper, or master cylinder during end-of-line test.
defects.recommended_action: Quarantine vehicle, do not release, rework by certified technician, retest full brake system before release.

defects.description: Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) diagnostic trouble code indicating airbag deployment circuit fault, connector fault, or sensor failure.
defects.recommended_action: Vehicle held at end-of-line, SRS system re-diagnosed and repaired by trained technician, full system re-test required before release.

defects.defect_type: Body Panel Gap Out of Tolerance
defects.description: Panel-to-panel gap or flush condition (e.g., door, hood, fender) outside specified tolerance band.
defects.recommended_action: Adjust at trim/final line if within correctable range, log for SPC trend, escalate to Major if recurring on same station.

defects.description: Cosmetic paint finish deviation such as orange peel, runs, dirt-in-paint, or minor color mismatch.
defects.recommended_action: Buff/polish rework if within cosmetic spec; escalate to Major if defect is on a highly visible panel and cannot be corrected without repaint.

defects.description: Critical fastener (wheel, suspension, steering, seatbelt anchor, engine mount) torqued below specified value, detected via torque audit or DC tool data.
defects.recommended_action: Vehicle held, fastener re-torqued and verified by certified technician, tool recalibrated, containment audit of same shift's output.

defects.description: Visible surface oxidation on body panel or underbody component prior to or after paint application.
defects.recommended_action: Segregate affected units, assess coating coverage, review pre-paint storage conditions.

defects.description: Wiring harness insulation damaged, pinched, or chafed against a structural or moving component, creating short-circuit or fire risk.
defects.recommended_action: Vehicle held, harness inspected and repaired/replaced, routing verified against build spec, containment check of same-shift output.

defects.description: Closure panel (door, hood, trunk/liftgate) misaligned relative to body opening, affecting operation or appearance.
defects.recommended_action: Rework at trim/final line, verify hinge and striker adjustment, log for SPC trend.

defects.description: Toe, camber, or caster measurement outside specification during end-of-line alignment check.
defects.recommended_action: Re-align at end-of-line, verify suspension component torque and installation, escalate to Critical if unable to bring within spec.

defects.description: Visible gap or misalignment in interior trim components (dash, console, door panels) not affecting function.
defects.recommended_action: Log for trend monitoring; rework at final line if within correctable range.

defects.description: Superficial scratch or dent on exterior body panel not affecting structural integrity.
defects.recommended_action: Cosmetic rework (paintless dent repair / touch-up) if within customer-visible zone; log for trend monitoring.

defects.description: Electronic Control Unit (ECU) failed to flash correctly, has incorrect software/calibration version, or fails post-flash verification.
defects.recommended_action: Vehicle held, re-flash with correct verified calibration, full functional test before release, log calibration version for traceability.

defects.description: Engine oil, coolant, brake fluid, or transmission fluid level outside specified range at end-of-line check.
defects.recommended_action: Correct fill level, inspect for leak source if level is low, re-verify before release.

defects.description: Seatbelt anchor or buckle fastener missing, cross-threaded, or below specified torque.
defects.recommended_action: Vehicle held, anchor point re-secured and torque-verified by certified technician, containment audit of same-shift output.
